what: Quiet-log staging is gated on an existing breadcrumbs source_dir
scenario_or_breakage: `larch_log_publish_breadcrumbs_shared` returns 0 when `source_dir` is missing; `larch_log_breadcrumb_source_dir` still returns `$session_root/breadcrumbs` even if that directory was never created. Implement/design sessions can have `larch-quiet-<script>-<pid>.log` at the tmpdir root (lib-quiet default) without ever creating `breadcrumbs/` (only created when `LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM` / Family B monitors run). Commit then silently drops the new forensics the PR is meant to add.
suggested_fix: Keep the ndjson no-source short-circuit, but compute `session_root=$(dirname "$source_dir")` first and run the quiet-log loop when `session_root` passes `larch_log_breadcrumbs_under_session_tmp`; only skip the ndjson loop when `source_dir` is absent. Add a harness case with quiet logs at tmpdir root and no `breadcrumbs/` directory.
